{{Infobox place|name=The Light Heights|type=Region|region=Northwest of [[the Banner-lands]]|house=[[House Whitehart]]}}
Harsh, weather-beaten highlands in the Silent Mountains' northwestern bend. Survival required shared faith and willingness to sacrifice — the country that shaped [[House Whitehart]]. High, silent valleys where goatherds keep their flocks beneath [[The Bell of Silence (seat)|the Bell of Silence]].
